correctness.rationale: The six-neighbor adjacency is exactly (XY)^(-1)(1+X)(1+Y)(1+XY) over F2; the row/column-even image of the first two factors has dimension (m−1)(n−1), and diagonal-shift-fixed functions meet it in one parity hyperplane of dimension gcd(m,n)−1 since m/g and n/g are coprime. Rank-nullity therefore gives rank=mn−m−n−g+2 and nullity=m+n+g−2 for all m,n≥3. Alternating binary rank is even. Independently reconstructed bitwise elimination gave ranks 2,6,6,8,14,34 for (m,n)=(3,3),(3,4),(4,4),(3,5),(4,6),(6,8), matching the formula.
